body:
## What to build

Return collectable SQLite Margin summaries when a public dimension, fixed key, summary output, or Grouping set identifier is named `TRUE` or `FALSE`, including case variants.

At main commit `b6f9faba946521aeb92fcf2c5655a2c3bf608ec8`, an ordinary dbplyr grouped sum over a source column named `TRUE` succeeds. The corresponding Margin summary fails during collection with `no such column: TRUE`, for both a single grouping set and a rollup, with or without Margin order. Typed-missing and string Margin labels all reproduce. Summary outputs and identifiers named `TRUE` or `FALSE` also fail.

A raw SQL control isolated the backend behavior: a quoted Boolean-word alias is retained at the top level but renamed to `column1` when a subquery containing the aliased constant is projected with a star. Margin construction introduces those intermediate names and later refers to the requested public name. This is a generated-query composition failure rather than an invalid source schema.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Direct collection returns the expected names, values, row counts, and grouping identity for both Boolean words and mixed-case spellings in the affected public roles.
- [ ] Single-set and rollup reports work with no ordering and both Margin-order directions, with typed-missing and string labels.
- [ ] Direct materialization preserves the same public schema and existing SQLite declared-type guarantees.
- [ ] Regressions exercise a live SQLite connection and include a successful direct dplyr control.
- [ ] Construction adds no unrequested source-data read.

## Blocked by

None (can start immediately).

## Investigation evidence

[2026-10-25 investigation and cause-isolating controls](https://github.com/sayuks/marginplyr/blob/9d10d84095181e07b7db4554608f389a234890c7/investigation/2026-10-25-grouping-summary-bug-hunt/README.md#f3-sqlite-intermediate-queries-lost-boolean-word-public-names) include the pinned main baseline, environment, and expected/actual behavior. [Public-contract replay](https://github.com/sayuks/marginplyr/blob/9d10d84095181e07b7db4554608f389a234890c7/investigation/2026-10-25-grouping-summary-bug-hunt/reproduce.R) and [measured baseline output](https://github.com/sayuks/marginplyr/blob/9d10d84095181e07b7db4554608f389a234890c7/investigation/2026-10-25-grouping-summary-bug-hunt/reproduce-output.txt) preserve the executable evidence.

comments.body:
Evidence and runnable probes are recorded in [the dated investigation](https://github.com/sayuks/marginplyr/blob/4a85bb32185cdb298985a0a65af0554aefc9c0a9/investigation/expand-grouping-bug-hunt-2026-10-25.md#tracked-observations-and-excluded-leads) and PR #840. The note pins the inspected snapshot and distinguishes observed failures from successful controls and excluded leads. No package implementation is included.

The additional observation used `expand_with_margins()` identifiers. The companion `tracked-names.R` contrasts the failing expansion with successful ordinary mutation; no duplicate ticket was created.

title: [P2] Preserve TRUE and FALSE column names in SQLite Margin summaries
